title_es: Bloqueo de la correa antes de desatascarla
description: Clear a rock jammed in an ore conveyor safely: stop the belt, open the isolation switch, put your personal padlock and tag on it, test that the belt cannot start, and only then reach in. Seen from a fixed security camera: isolation switch box on the left, conveyor on the right.

steps.instruction_es: Detén la correa con la parada de emergencia.
Gira la manilla roja del interruptor a OFF.
steps.completion_cue: the red rotary handle on the grey box is horizontal (OFF)

steps.instruction_es: Pon tu candado y tu tarjeta en la manilla.
steps.completion_cue: a red padlock hangs from the big red rotary handle on the grey box at the left (attached to the handle itself, not held in a hand)

steps.instruction_es: Prueba el arranque: la correa no debe moverse.
steps.completion_cue: the worker's gloved finger is pressing a green START button next to the conveyor

steps.instruction_es: Ahora sí, saca la roca atascada.
steps.completion_cue: the rock is out of the belt

mistakes.description: The worker reaches into the conveyor before locking out and testing the isolation switch.
mistakes.visual_cue: the worker reaches into the conveyor or grips the jammed rock while NO padlock hangs from the red handle of the isolation switch
mistakes.correction_es: ¡Alto! No metas las manos: la correa no está bloqueada. Pon tu candado primero.
